title: Geocode an address against a GeocodeServer locator
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that forward-geocodes the single-line address "410 Atkinson Dr, Honolulu, HI 96814" against the locator "EvalLocator" hosted at the base URL in HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL. Use HonuaGeocodingClient from @honua/sdk-js/geocoding constructed with { baseUrl: <base URL>, locatorName: "EvalLocator" } and its forwardGeocode(address) method, which resolves to an array of { address, latitude, longitude, score }. Print exactly one line to stdout: {"count": <number of candidates>, "address": <first candidate address>, "score": <first candidate score>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: forward geocoding via the dedicated geocoding subpath export.
